Now verify notes.txt: one line, content. And final overall verification of all three outputs.

Let me run final checks: line count of notes, cat -A, and confirm sum digits and word count mentioned. Also verify all files exist.
message.content: Final end-to-end verification of all three deliverables.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "set -e
echo "=== out/ listing ==="; ls -la out
echo "=== notes line count (must be 1) ==="; wc -l < out/notes.txt
echo "=== notes raw ==="; cat -A out/notes.txt
echo "=== notes mentions both results? ==="; grep -q '44' out/notes.txt && grep -q '5' out/notes.txt && echo NOTES_OK
echo "=== final sum ==="; cat out/sum.txt
echo "=== final words ==="; cat out/words.txt
echo "=== sha256 ==="; sha256sum out/sum.txt out/words.txt out/notes.txt"}
